notes.title: Update 0.9.2
notes.content:
0.9.2 Update notes


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/8fe14272dd45ebd3bc8486f537a5b855cfc23b9a.png"]

Hi everyone! The Ember Guardian is going to Tokyo Game Show 2025 this week, and to prepare for this special occasion, I am pushing a substantial update to the demo, including visual polishing, combat balance, building improvements, and Japanese localization. Here are some highlights of this patch:

 
Visuals
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/56ae5a59ff352ee03a5f2646717ed464e129ce89.png"]

The first thing you will notice right after starting the game: you can now play as a female character, completed with new sounds and animation. You can also switch the player character whenever you like using main menu settings.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/be53b7c02987b4fd88230a584d58ca6942ab220f.png"]

In addition, The Ember Guardian has a new logo! You can now find it on the main menu, and it matches the ambiance very well!




Combat


Combat being a core mechanic of The Ember Guardian has always been a focus of community feedback, and I’ve taken this change address some of the issues. To begin with, rolling now no longer cancels reloading and this should make combat a lot more fluid.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/6d1125c4cc96641348f9ccc5ca2da10e63251665.png"]

Enemies now react to players in a more natural manner – crawlers and wasps do not always immediately swarm the player, allowing more breathing room during combat. But don’t be too comfortable, as crawlers have learnt to flank you from both sides, and the armored slugs can shrug off your bullets with their tough shell.

 
Buildings
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/0f09d19f602b44baa5a1680ee839f14150bfac08.png"]

Upgraded towers can now host two hunters to double their firepower. You can also work on buildings during the night, even when you’re under attack. Having the option to build new towers or barricades and even repairing damaged ones should give players more tactical flexibility.

 



These are only a few of the numerous updates introduced in this patch, ranging from gameplay balancing to bug fixes. For the full list of changes, you can see the full patch notes below:



Balancing:

Barricades are now fully repairable at night

Level 2 towers can now host 2 hunters instead of 1 (localization)

“Slug” type creature’s shell now makes bullets bounce off!

Spam QTE progress/key pressed + 10%

SMG accuracy debuff when moving and running decreased

Decreased rifle accuracy when using semi-auto mode

Crawlers and Wasps chance to aggro player on weapon shoot : 100% → 50%

Crawlers can now flank the player

Reduced teleportation skill delay between activation and teleportation : 2s → 1.5s

Trainer’s Max HP upgrade is now capped at level 3



Visuals

Added female player character

New logo! Title screen has been updated.

Replaced the Hunter Shrine visuals

Changed fire visuals when fueling it with orbs

Improved the Eternal Flame’s look

Added talk lines to the player that replace some of the tool tips

Reworked the SMG visuals

Improved hunter arrows trajectories & visuals

Changed gem visuals : newly collected gems now look “raw”, and dropping them in the chest “purifies them”, making them usable for the merchants



QOL

Gun chests no longer replace your weapon completely : you can now swap back to your initial weapon using “tab”

Rolling doesn’t restart the whole reloading process anymore

Towers & barricades are now upgradable at night

Paying an orb to fuel the fire now instantly adds fuel (removed the part with the orb falling into fire)

Doggo now doesn’t growl or bark if set on “Stay” behavior

Crouching now reduces the player’s collider vertical size

Improved gamepad aiming (auto aim, gamepad axial deadzone, rest cursor position…)

Current day displayed every morning

Decreased SFX volume for shotgun hit sounds

Added an SFX when player starts changing weapons

Weapon cursor is now hidden while the player is swapping weapons and cannot shoot



Surge window:

Fixed surge window stacking

Damage numbers are blue when under surge window buff

Crit hit no longer stackable with surge window damage buff

Added minimum delay of 60s between surges



Localization

Added Japanese localization



Optimization

Creatures far away from player are now set in hibernation

Optimized audio memory usage

Fixed some performance bugs when the backpack was too full of small orbs



BugFixes :

Petting dog does not change the dog’s state anymore (follow ↔ stay)

Fixed a bug with weapon precision when swapping weapons

Objective UI correctly displayed at the center of the screen

Fixed animals die animation looping indefinitely

Auto aim now also works on wasp nests

Fixed a bug where the last bullet of a surged weapon would not deal increased damage

Fixed a bug where interacting with a weapon chest while opening would re-trigger the opening SFX & animation

Fixed a bug where trap slots would display as buildable even when the player has no traps in his inventory

Fixed a bug where a destroyed barricade could be upgraded at night

Fixed a bug where the ammo bar would not show when reloading close to the ammo crafter

Fixed accuracy values drifting during a run

Fixed an animation bug where dying would not turn the player transparent

notes.title: 🎉 10,000 WISHLISTS! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello Guardians!


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/679fe406e350705089757e67261b7ab849d04231.jpg"]

The last few months have been pretty crazy for me and The Ember Guardian: demo launch, shooting overhaul, working on new content… the game has come a pretty long way. In July, we've finally passed the 10,000 wishlist mark – a major milestone for an indie game. Thank you to everyone for playing my demo, and shoutout to content creators who shared my game with their communities. I could not have done it without your help (and hundreds of hours of playtime).

 

Knowing that so many of you are waiting to play my game has really motivated me to go all in on development. I’ve been working on a lot of new content, including new weapons, new buildings, new abilities, new upgrades, and even new doggos. While not everything will appear in the demo, I still hope you will look forward to the full game where you can wield the full arsenal against the encroaching darkness. Here are some screenshots for a quick preview on what I've been working on:


[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/f23b437f7228a9888d2f3661ca1997d394cafa0c.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/9cb747e5825373b2510b87cb0b0d559b31d39721.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/3f7280f4ca20fadc772af12ec47f1751fa18162e.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/f64abbb890c52733920990e527d786c3664e33eb.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/2669277e757892c833fe0fe0b0f68c826194a679.jpg"][/carousel]
 

Starting from next month, I’ll be posting regular Steam blogs (hopefully once every month). Just something to keep everyone updated on development progress and any relevant news of The Ember Guardian. Don't forget to follow me on my socials to get the latest news and some behind-the-scenes devlogs. See you in September!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9.1
notes.content:
An update to rework the gun jamming system, and address some minor issues:


Weapon Surge System
After reviewing the previous gun jam system, I have decided to change it into a more rewarding than punishing mechanic. It is now renamed as the Surge System.

The QTE is now optional with a time window

If the QTE skill check is successfully completed within the window, the next bullets will gain a x2 damage boost

The “Stability” upgrade (originating from the jam mechanic) is replaced by the “Surge Efficiency” upgrade, increasing the number of bullets buffed after each surge


QoL
Reduced response time when using orbs on buildings and chests


Balancing
Added 2 foxes on each side of the main map

Increased hunter accuracy during the night

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

 

Demo Update 0.9 is now online! After testing out the new gun play mechanics in the beta branch, they have now made their way into the official demo. Let me know what you think about the changes! If you'd like to share your feedback or suggestions, feel free to join our Discord and/or leave a comment on our socials or Steam discussion board.




0.9 Update notes
 
Shooting system overhaul
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550050/6174bfa65ece7029b732f68ca280169093f3403e.png"]

New accuracy system: The reticle has brackets showing your weapon’s accuracy zone.

The aiming point moves within this zone to reflect shot precision, and your shots will always land precisely where the point is located. No more aiming straight at a small creature and missing because of random weapon spread!

The accuracy of your weapon reacts to the following statuses : walking, running, exhausted, crouching, shooting and taking damage.

You now also feel the difference in weapon weight with their reticle point following the brackets at different speeds.

Reloading simplified: Adding a clip from your belt to your weapon is now automatically performed when trying to shoot with an empty clip. This behavior can still be turned back to manual in the settings.

Weapon Jams: Shooting now has a chance of jamming your weapon, initiating a QTE to repair it. Weapons have different QTE lengths.

Two new weapon upgrades added: Field Reliability Mod (reduces jam probability) and Quick-Clear Lever (reduces the amount of inputs in jam QTEs

Weak spots: hitting a creature's weak spot now deal increased flat damage.

Critical hits: are now also possible when not hitting a weak spot.

Added damage numbers: turned on by default, but can be turned off in the settings.

 
Hunter AI improvements
Hunters can now take over another hunter’s assigned animal if they are closer to it than the current hunter.

Hunters can now shoot incoming creatures during dawn

Added RNG to the Hunter's shots during night attacks

 
Spanish localization is now available, thanks to an awesome community member !
 
Balancing
Unlocked the Max Stamina upgrade in the demo !

Decreased double arsenal mastery price (10 -> 5 green gems)

Decreased Shotgun & SMG prices (8 -> 2 red gems)

Decreased Weapon swap time upgrades by 1 gem

You now recover stamina much faster when standing still

Removed shotgun focus blast damage nerf : full focus blast damage 80 -> 120

 
QOL
Added a new video tip for Gun Jamming

Added a new video tip for weapon management when buying a new weapon

Changed tip description from "To open backpack" to "To display backpack"

Changed tower description in the Gem Merchant's shop to specify damage & range upgrades are specific to the hunters

Character menu (tab) is now closeable with the ESC key

 
Bug Fixes
Bullets should now bounce way less often when landing.

Wind sounds are now affected by the SFX volume setting

Fixed the Demo Completed Video Tip panel layout

Fixed a bug where the hub chest would stay open if the player exits its trigger area while the opening animation is running.

Rolling when crouching now plays the rolling animation

Fixed the "?" over the hunter's head being reversed when they flip

Fixed hunters shooting at dead target during night attacks

Fixed a bug where crawlers would stop moving while crossing bridges when attempting to jump

 
Tweaks
Added torches/lights to the wild emberling camps

Moved the "holding orbs" indicator from the hunters to not overlap with status indicators

Bullet collision when standing close to a barricade is more permissive.

Hub Chest sound level reduced

Moved the Chest & Backpack UI layers behind the shop UI

Changing weapon panel now has a background, an outline and empty weapon slots

 

I hope you enjoy the features! Follow us on our socials for the latest news on The Ember Guardian!

notes.title: Demo Update 0.9 Beta

notes.title: Demo Update 0.8.2
notes.content:
Balancing

The boss is no longer affected by the shock trap.
The shock trap's slowing effect no longer stacks.

QOL

Critical hits now come with enhanced feedback.

Bug Fixes

The weapon icon in the character menu now updates when picking up a new weapon from a chest in the tutorial area.

notes.content:
UW Compatibility

Windowed mode display now allows resizing the window (5120 x 1440 resolution is not compatible yet)
Balancing

Rifle accuracy : +30%
Summoners and wasp nests now immediately spawn an enemy when the player eliminates a minion, if their max spawned minion number is reached.

QOL improvements

Increased the visibility of the wasps and of the nest
Time required holding interact to light fire : -50%
Reduced worker waiting time before dropping orbs
Reduced time needed to be able to pick up orbs again when dropped by player 3s → 2s

Bug Fixes

Fixed a bug where the player would drop an orb when collecting ammo from the crafter.

 New towers and barricades can now be built during the night. However, you cannot repair/upgrade your barricades during a night attack.
